description: Expand your RYOBI 18V ONE+ System with the RYOBI 18V ONE+ LED Spotlight. Illuminate large distances with over 3,000 Lumens of LED light output and a 650 yard beam distance. We've upgraded this light with 3 mode settings (high/medium/low) while also making it 26% more compact than our previous model. A unique feature of this spotlight is its hanging loop for convenient storage with the added capability of being used on its sides and back. Best of all, it is part of the RYOBI ONE+ System of over 260 Cordless Tools that all work on the same battery platform. This RYOBI 18V ONE+ LED Spotlight is backed by the RYOBI 3-Year Manufacturer’s Warranty and includes (1) PCL661 18V ONE+ LED Spotlight and (1) Operator's Manual. Battery and charger sold separately.
